name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.D_eq_upper_sub_lower
source_header: theorem D_eq_upper_sub_lower (s : ℝ) : D s = upper s - lower s

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.log_bounds
source_header:
theorem log_bounds (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    (logLower n q : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((q : ℝ) - 1) ∧
      Real.log ((q : ℝ) - 1) ≤ (logUpper n q : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.lower_rational_node_bounds
source_header:
theorem lower_rational_node_bounds (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ)
    (hq2 : 2 ≤ q) (hq4 : q ≤ 4) :
    ((logLower n q / q : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ lower (q : ℝ) ∧
      lower (q : ℝ) ≤ ((logUpper n q / q : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.upper_rational_node_eq
source_header:
theorem upper_rational_node_eq (q : ℚ) (hq1 : 1 < q) (hq3 : q ≤ 3) :
    upper (q : ℝ) = ((1 / q : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.D_rational_node_bounds
source_header:
theorem D_rational_node_bounds (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ)
    (hq2 : 2 ≤ q) (hq3 : q ≤ 3) :
    (((1 - logUpper n q) / q : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ D (q : ℝ) ∧
      D (q : ℝ) ≤ (((1 - logLower n q) / q : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.lower_rational_cell_bounds
source_header:
theorem lower_rational_cell_bounds (n : ℕ) (a b : ℚ) (s : ℝ)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 4) (has : (a : ℝ) ≤ s) (hsb : s ≤ (b : ℝ)) :
    ((logLower n a / a : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ lower s ∧
      lower s ≤ ((logUpper n b / b : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.D_rational_cell_bounds
source_header:
theorem D_rational_cell_bounds (n : ℕ) (a b : ℚ) (s : ℝ)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 3) (has : (a : ℝ) ≤ s) (hsb : s ≤ (b : ℝ)) :
    (((1 - logUpper n b) / b : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ D s ∧
      D s ≤ (((1 - logLower n a) / a : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.log_two_bounds
source_header:
theorem log_two_bounds : (693147 : ℝ) / 1000000 ≤ Real.log 2 ∧
    Real.log 2 ≤ (693148 : ℝ) / 1000000

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.D_le_rational_quadratic_tail
source_header:
theorem D_le_rational_quadratic_tail {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) :
    D s ≤ (920559 : ℝ) / (1000000 * s ^ 2)

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.D_rational_tail_cell_bounds
source_header:
theorem D_rational_tail_cell_bounds (a : ℚ) (s : ℝ)
    (ha : 3 ≤ a) (has : (a : ℝ) ≤ s) :
    0 ≤ D s ∧ D s ≤ ((920559 / (1000000 * a ^ 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: ImbalancedChen.P2ContinuousSieveRational.upper_le_lower_add_rational_tail
source_header:
theorem upper_le_lower_add_rational_tail {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) :
    upper s ≤ lower s + (920559 : ℝ) / (1000000 * s ^ 2)
